definitions.BASE_CONTAMINATION: A frozen original base among the 60 is found not to be clean before its controlled edit.
definitions.CONTROL_CONTAMINATION: A CLEAN_CONTROL item is found to contain a material objective defect under fixed source evidence.
definitions.MUTATION_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: A CONTEXT_MUTANT or SURFACE_MUTANT fails the registered one-atom or arm-decidability manipulation rule.

counting_unit: unique event_id and item_id; an event may signal multiple gate classes but is not multiplied by route, run, arm, or response
